title: The State of Independent Funeral Home Websites 2026
note: Aggregates computed from automated scans. No individual site is identified.
attribution: Free to use and cite under CC BY 4.0. Credit Clikiti with a link.
citation: Clikiti. (2026, October 15). The state of independent funeral home websites 2026 (Q4 2026) [Report]. https://clikiti.com/research/funeral/2026-q4
audience: Web agencies and freelancers selling to independent and family-owned funeral homes
findings: Only 13% of the 175 independent funeral home websites we scanned name a religious or cultural tradition they serve.
A typical site answers five of the ten questions families ask before choosing (mean 5.3).
The median overall score is 78 out of 100 (mean 77).
The least-answered questions are "Can you honour our faith or culture?" (13%), "Can family far away watch?" (22%) and "Do other families vouch for you?" (30%).
The best-answered are "Can I plan my own arrangements?" (97%) and "When and where is the service?" (93%).

By kind of business, the highest median score is 79 (family funeral homes, one location), against 78 for family firms with two or three locations, 78 for cremation-focused providers and 77 for faith and cultural community homes.
26% fail "Loads in under 2.5 s on a phone" (Core Web Vitals · LCP).

agencyProblems.label: Religious and cultural traditions named
agencyProblems.question: Can you honour our faith or culture?
agencyProblems.fix: A traditions page that names the faiths and cultures the home serves, the customs it can arrange and the clergy and communities it works with.
agencyProblems.pitch: A family looks for its own tradition by name. "All faiths" does not tell them you know it.

agencyProblems.label: Text contrast passes 4.5:1
agencyProblems.fix: Raise text contrast to at least 4.5:1 in the theme, including obituary text.
agencyProblems.pitch: Older relatives read your obituaries. Faint text is the first thing they meet, and it is a WCAG failure.

agencyProblems.label: Livestreamed services offered
agencyProblems.question: Can family far away watch?
agencyProblems.fix: Say whether services can be watched online, and put each stream link on the obituary page for that service.
agencyProblems.pitch: Relatives far away look for the stream first, and your site never says you offer one.

agencyProblems.label: Reviews marked up, in a widget or quoted
agencyProblems.question: Do other families vouch for you?
agencyProblems.fix: Show families’ reviews on the site, with Review or AggregateRating markup.
agencyProblems.pitch: Families already thank you in public. Your own site does not show it.

agencyProblems.label: Cremation or burial prices shown
agencyProblems.question: What will cremation or a burial cost?
agencyProblems.fix: Publish starting prices for direct cremation, a cremation with a service and a traditional funeral with burial, each with what it includes.
agencyProblems.pitch: A family deciding tonight can see a cremation price on a broker’s site and none on yours.
